sources: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/WickhamCampground (Camping, Rates and Rules tabs, read in a browser)

values.note: Brevard County residents $25.67 a night all year; non-residents $36.37 (May-October) and $38.68 in the November 1-April 30 season, which applies to non-residents only. Plus 7% sales and 5% tourist tax. A $2 nightly sewage site fee applies to sites with sewer access, residents and non-residents alike. Residency is proven with a Florida driver's license or ID showing a Brevard address.

fees.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/WickhamCampground (Rates: 'Brevard County Resident Daily Camping Rates ... Wickham $25.67 $25.67', 'Brevard County Non-Resident Daily Camping Rates ... Wickham $36.37 $38.68', 'Sewage Site Fee (Campers) $2.00 daily', 'Seasonal rates apply from November 1 through April 30', 'Sales Tax 7% Tourist Tax 5%'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/WickhamCampground ('Campgrounds feature 133 full hook-up campsites'; rates: 'any site at all 3 campgrounds that include sewer access'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Dump station for a fee. The A-loop restroom/shower/laundry building is being demolished and rebuilt until about May 2027; A-loop campers use B loop's, and C loop has restrooms only.

facilities.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/WickhamCampground ('shower & laundry facilities for registered campers, and RV dump stations available for a fee'; 'Construction has begun to demolish the existing restroom/showers/laundry facility in “A” loop ... expected to last until May 2027 ... There are restrooms only in “C” loop'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve in person, online (Brevard County WebTrac), by email or by phone. Brevard County residents book up to 395 days (13 months) ahead, non-residents 180 days (6 months). Maximum 90 days per reservation for RVs (14 for tents), then 48 hours away before returning; minimum one night. One free date change per reservation. Check-out 11 a.m. Cancelling 7+ days ahead costs a $20 processing fee.

booking.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/WickhamCampground ('Reservations can be made in person, online, email, or by telephone. Brevard County residents can make reservations up to 395 days (13 months) in advance of the stay. Non-residents can make reservations up to 180 days (6 months)', 'The maximum length of stay for RVs and camping units is 90 days per reservation', 'The minimum length of stay is one night', 'Customers who check out after 11:00 AM'; 'Book a Campground' link to WebTrac), read 2026-10-21

summary: Brevard County's campground page: resident $25.67/night (non-resident $36.37, $38.68 Nov-Apr; +$2 sewer sites), 133 full-hookup sites, showers/laundry/dump (A-loop bathhouse rebuilt until May 2027), WebTrac/phone/email booking, 395-day resident window (180 non-resident), 90-night max. Not stated: electric amperage, rig length, season. AWH note kept.
